title: This Bird Flew for 11 Days Without Ever Landing
subject: bar-tailed godwit

scenes.text: This bird flew eleven days and never landed.
In 2020, a male godwit left Alaska, headed for New Zealand, tracked by a tiny satellite tag.
That's about twelve thousand kilometers, mostly over open Pacific Ocean.
Before leaving, godwits fatten up, and even shrink some of their internal organs, to fly lighter.
He sometimes flew up to fifty-five miles an hour.
The bird that never landed was flying home. Eleven days to get there.

description:
A bar-tailed godwit flew about 12,000 km from Alaska to New Zealand in 11 days without stopping.
Godwits fatten up and shrink some internal organs first, so they can fly lighter.
Could you last eleven days without landing?
first_comment: Eleven days without landing: could you last eleven days without your phone? What animal record next?
